expectations.text: Preserves 18 nurses, four weeks, one clinic, and voluntary participation.
expectations.evidence: "A voluntary four-week pilot at one clinic" and "Among 18 participating nurses" retain all four design details.

expectations.text: Preserves median weekly 46 to 39 minutes with no causal claim and explains no control plus concurrent staffing changes.
expectations.evidence: "Median weekly scheduling time fell from 46 to 39 minutes" is followed by "Without a control group, that change cannot be attributed to the tool; concurrent staffing changes may have contributed."

expectations.text: States six of nine survey respondents preferred it rather than six of 18 or a majority of all nurses.
expectations.evidence: "Nine nurses completed the optional survey, and six preferred the tool" explicitly fixes the denominator, reinforced by "only half the participants."

expectations.text: States patient safety was not measured; any next step is framed as recommendation, not a planned commitment.
expectations.evidence: "The pilot did not measure patient safety" retains the unknown; "A reasonable next step is a longer, controlled evaluation" is expressly a recommendation.
